name: Xbox Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchases - 19.24% to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness and other factors. This APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Balance transfers - 19.24% to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee: 3% (per official Terms and Conditions).

base_rate.description: Earn 1X card points for every $1 spent on everyday purchases.

categories.label: 5X card points on eligible products at the digital Microsoft Store
3X card points on eligible streaming services (e.g. Netflix, Disney+, Spotify)
3X card points on eligible dining delivery services (e.g. Grubhub, DoorDash)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem card points on eligible purchases at xbox.com, Microsoft.com, on console, and in-game (applied as a credit on your billing statement).

signup_bonus.description: Earn 5,000 bonus card points after making your first purchase within the first 180 days of account opening. That's a $50 value.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: Enjoy all of the card benefits for $0 annual fee.

benefits.title: Digital wallets flexibility
benefits.description: Enjoy the flexibility of digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay.

benefits.title: Complimentary FICO Credit Score
benefits.description: Online access to your FICO Credit Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for the charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: 3 months of Game Pass Ultimate
benefits.description: Earn 3 months of Game Pass Ultimate for new Game Pass members after making your first purchase within the first 180 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Two 3-month Game Pass Ultimate gift codes
benefits.description: When you spend $7,000 or more within your first 12 months of opening your account, you earn two 3-month codes to gift to friends or family to try Game Pass Ultimate for the first time.

benefits.title: Personalize your card
benefits.description: Choose from one of five iconic card designs and personalize with your gamertag.

notes: Verified against the official Barclays product page on 2026-07-25. Foreign transaction fee is 3% (per Terms and Conditions). Earn rates: 5X at the digital Microsoft Store, 3X on eligible streaming services, 3X on eligible dining delivery services, 1X on everyday purchases.
